query: Why do some agents have longer resolution times?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Categorizing incidents from short_description gives a strong axis to group resolution times by problem type, directly relevant to the query. Sample values (database, vpn, network_connectivity, software_application) are sound readings of the descriptions.

per_column.name: incident_symptom_type
per_column.rationale: Symptom type is a useful orthogonal axis (outage vs. slow vs. error) plausibly correlated with resolution effort. Mostly grounded, though 'error_message' for 'Software update issue' and 'slow_degraded_performance' for 'connection unstable' are somewhat loose inferences from terse text.

per_column.name: affected_system_scope
per_column.rationale: Scope (individual vs. server vs. systemic) is a genuinely useful driver of resolution time. However values are frequently inferred beyond what terse descriptions state, e.g. 'Unable to access the database' -> 'server_infrastructure' and 'VPN issue' -> 'individual_device' are guesses the text does not clearly warrant.

per_column.name: ticket_handoff
per_column.rationale: Whether a ticket was handed off could plausibly explain longer resolution times and is analytically useful. But the source text shown (short_description plus timestamps) provides no basis for a True/False handoff flag; assignment_group/assigned_to differences aren't evidenced in the samples, so values appear largely invented.

per_column.name: recurrence_indicator
per_column.rationale: Recurrence is relevant to resolution-time analysis. Yet grounding is weak: 'VPN issue, frequent disconnection' clearly signals recurrence but is marked False, and other rows are flagged without textual support, indicating values are not reliably derived from the source.

judge.rationale: All five columns supply genuine, non-redundant axes (category, symptom, scope, handoff, recurrence) for explaining resolution-time variation, so analytical usefulness is high across the board. Groundedness is mixed: the category and symptom columns are sound readings of short_description, but affected_system_scope, ticket_handoff, and recurrence_indicator assert specifics the sampled source text does not support (including a contradiction where 'frequent disconnection' is marked non-recurring), lowering the table-level groundedness.
